verdicts.reason: Both share the same broken structure. The 'Find It Near You' CTA shrinks to a tiny pill at the top and gets lost among the badges. The sage circle is cut off from the can and sits behind the headline and badges, and 'back' is left alone on its own line. The GROVE wordmark has dropped below the headline, and the pills are cramped against the 'FREE DELIVERY' tag. A also has ragged left edges: the headline and GROVE sit at about x=30, while the pills and body copy sit at about x=17. A leaves dead space both above and below. B keeps everything on one left edge, so it is slightly better, but it pushes the pills almost against the top edge and leaves about 230px of empty space at the bottom.
